gameName: Betrayal at House on the Hill
editionLabel: Avalon Hill (Hasbro) English rules, second edition
firstPlayerRule: The explorer with the next birthday goes first. Use the birthday printed on each explorer’s character card, not the players’ own birthdays.
clarifications: Players take turns clockwise (to the left) following the first explorer.

sources.title: Betrayal at House on the Hill Second Edition — Rules & Instructions
sources.location: Setup, final bullet “See who goes first”, and How to Play (PDF page 3, printed spread 4–5); copyright on PDF page 1

internalEvidence: Downloaded https://instructions.hasbro.com/api/download/F3148_en-us_avalon-hill-betrayal-at-house-on-the-hill-second-edition-cooperative-board-game.pdf, the English (US) rules listed on Hasbro’s official instructions page https://instructions.hasbro.com/en-us/instruction/avalon-hill-betrayal-at-house-on-the-hill-second-edition-cooperative-board-game. SHA-256: 94afbab9b3fc51c7a4a0098f9d583c64aaee398b84093be58c12a5523b3af596. Read the extracted text of PDF pages 1 and 3. PDF page 3 (printed spread 4–5), setup: ‘See who goes first. The explorer who has the next birthday goes first. (Look on your explorer’s character card…)’, then turns go clockwise; How to Play repeats that turns start with the first player and go left. PDF page 1 shows Betrayal at House on the Hill, Avalon Hill and © 2021 Hasbro, item F3148 Second Edition, identifying the game (BGG 10547). For comparison, the official Hasbro 3rd-edition English (en-gb, F4541) rulebook setup step 13 also gives the first turn to the explorer with the next birthday; it is a separate BGG entry and not covered by this record. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: The rulebook gives no tie-break, but each explorer card shows a different birthday.
The first edition (2004) and third edition (2022) have their own rulebooks; this record covers the second edition.
